description: This file defines an abstract class 'dmQuery' which declares several pure virtual methods related to executing and managing data model queries. It serves as a base interface for query operations in the project.

classes.name: dmQuery
classes.description: An abstract interface representing a data model query, capable of execution, resetting, setting query strings, and retrieving results.

methods.name: ~dmQuery()
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the dmQuery class.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Pure virtual method to execute the query.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Pure virtual method to reset the query state.

methods.name: setQueryString
methods.description: Pure virtual method to set the query string with a given provider operation.

methods.name: results
methods.description: Pure virtual method to obtain the query results.
